findings.title: update's script fallback misses extension-scoped bash references, so a ps/py issues-pack adopter gets the bash-flavoured github skill
findings.reason: Intent: support script flavours and keep existing update behaviour. init.mjs:58 now flavours .specify/extensions/<id>/scripts/bash/ references, but the update scriptFallback skip at update.mjs:137 still matches only '.specify/scripts/bash/'. The 1.0.11 issues skill matched that skip and was preserved, so this is a regression for issues-pack adopters.
findings.x-evidence: Raised independently by adversarial-reviewer (0.82) and testing-reviewer (0.72); confidence boosted for agreement. When uv or the wheel is unavailable, update.mjs:88-94 sets scriptFallback and re-stages with sh. The staged packs/issues/files/.github/skills/speckit-github-taskstoissues/SKILL.md:59 calls .specify/extensions/github/scripts/bash/resolve-tasks.sh, which the skip at update.mjs:137 does not match. An unmodified ps or py managed copy is overwritten with the bash copy, and a 1.0.11 adopter gets it as a new file, while W_SCRIPT_UNREFRESHED (update.mjs:112-113) says script-calling files were preserved. test/fixtures/speckit-1.0.11/speckit-taskstoissues/SKILL.md contains '.specify/scripts/bash/', so it was skipped before. The UV_OFFLINE fallback test (update.test.mjs ~306-384) installs only core, and scriptReference at update.test.mjs:42 is core-only.
findings.x-fix: Make the update.mjs:137 skip use the same pattern as init.flavouredBytes (/\.specify\/(?:extensions\/[^/]+\/)?scripts\/bash\//), ideally through a shared exported helper. Extend the ps/py UV_OFFLINE fallback test to --packs issues and widen scriptReference. This touches update.mjs, so record a decision against T026's 'no update-logic change' and D7. Whether the narrow fix restores existing fallback behaviour or needs an owner answer is the implementer's call.

findings.title: terminateTree reap poll rethrows Darwin EPERM for a zombie-only process group, so a timed-out check becomes a cleanup failure on macOS
findings.reason: The user asked for a correctness and portability review of commit 292d7b1 (D31). macOS is a supported platform (.github/workflows/smoke.yml macos-latest job). On Darwin, kill(-pgid, 0) on a group whose remaining members are all zombies returns EPERM, not ESRCH. The poll rethrows it, so runLocalCheck rejects with E_CHECK_FAILED 'process-tree cleanup failed' instead of resolving met:false for the timeout or output-limit reason.
findings.x-evidence: local-checks.mjs:41-44: only code ESRCH returns, anything else hits 'throw error'. stop() maps the rejection to E_CHECK_FAILED '... process-tree cleanup failed'. XNU's killpg1 skips SZOMB members and, with POSIX semantics, returns EPERM when it finds none. Reproductions are publicly reported (os.killpg on a zombie-only group gives PermissionError on macOS; signal 0 behaves like SIGKILL). The first poll runs synchronously right after SIGKILL, before libuv can reap the shell leader, and launchd-reparented grandchildren are briefly zombies, so the failure is intermittent. Linux is unaffected. Adversarial and security noted the same rethrow as a residual risk. No test reaches the poll (testing F05). Task mapping: D31 says the fix is outside the original task list and arose from the T030 npm run check run, so it is mapped to T030.
findings.x-fix: In the poll, treat EPERM as terminal on non-Windows (return when code is ESRCH or EPERM; SIGKILL was already delivered), or only on darwin if Linux EPERM should still surface. Add a mocked-process.kill unit test for EPERM on the poll and for deadline expiry (see F05).

findings.title: prepareSpeckitExtension guards and failure cleanup have no tests, and sync's call to it is never run hermetically
findings.reason: This new function decides which bytes become locked extension rows. Nothing in test/ references prepareSpeckitExtension or SPECKIT_EXTENSIONS, and no sync() test injects deps.prepareSpeckitExtension. If its guards or cleanup broke, npm test would still pass.
findings.x-evidence: upstream.mjs:99-122 has these branches: E_USAGE for an unsupported extension, E_UPSTREAM_VERIFY for a missing venv specify or core project, a missing extension.yml after 'specify extension add', and a catch that removes the partial tree and wraps the error. sync.mjs:458 calls use.prepareSpeckitExtension. test/unit/sync.test.mjs passes pre-built trees to prepareEntries. The only deps-injection test (sync-bump.test.mjs:117-128) injects prepareSpeckit only. The happy path is covered only by the hosted generator run and sync --check.
findings.x-fix: Add unit tests: an unsupported id gives E_USAGE; a missing work/venv/bin/specify or project gives E_UPSTREAM_VERIFY; with a fake specify that exits non-zero, or exits 0 without writing extension.yml, expect E_UPSTREAM_VERIFY, no project-github left behind and the core project unchanged. Add a sync() test with injected deps asserting the call uses extension 'github' and that errors propagate.

findings.title: Hash-locked requirements header records a local worktree path
findings.reason: The constitution's Supply-Chain & Licensing Constraints forbid local paths in Baton.
